metric_policy: NFKC, casefold, Unicode punctuation/symbols to spaces, collapse whitespace, decimal digits and English 0-199 / Roman Hindi 0-30 number words to digits. No translation or script transliteration. Raw metrics are preserved. Latin references and v3 codemix Hindi output may be cross-script; do not interpret those scores as a model ranking. Rules intent accuracy also reflects the extractor's script coverage.
